name: ui-sequencer-board
description: SequencerBoard — order-the-steps puzzle: player drags actions into a sequence-bar; CHECK compares the slot order against the solution; PLAY animates the sequence step-by-step.

schema.name: ui-sequencer-board
schema.description: SequencerBoard — order-the-steps puzzle: player drags actions into a sequence-bar; CHECK compares the slot order against the solution; PLAY animates the sequence step-by-step.

emits.description: slotDropEvent prop — emitted when the player drops an action into a slot
slotRemoveEvent prop — emitted when the player clears a slot
playEvent prop — starts step-by-step playback of the current sequence
checkEvent prop — submits the sequence for validation
playAgainEvent prop — reset slots and restart

maxSlots.label: Max Slots
